title: Treatise on the Hawk-Eye Sabre
summary: Trains the Xiantian student to read a foe's weak point at a glance and to cut or seal it with the sabre.

title: Canon of the Twin-Court Edge
summary: Sets two courts of the blade in answer so that one receives a blow and the other returns it with greater force.

title: Book of the Basin Current Edge
summary: Teaches the slow deep pull of water in a basin and the flooding rise that ends in a sudden flashing cut.

title: Canon of the Azure Dual Track
summary: Weaves the two tracks of the Azure Sky sabre into one whole until the blade can cancel a technique in the clash.

title: Treatise on the Paired Hawk Descent
summary: Sets two hawks upon one prey in the style of the sabre with a dive and a following dive that tears a guard apart.

title: Handbook of the River Beneath Azure
summary: Follows a river from its reed banks through rapids to a flood and ends in a cut that stops a foe's qi like a flood.

title: Discourse on the Twin Reversal
summary: Treats the sudden turning of every cut and step into its twin and the flash of motion that ends the exchange.

title: Study of the Deep Basin Guard
summary: A rare study for a Monarch of the sabre as a deep basin that holds still and cancels what pours into it.

title: Canon of the Oath Bearing Edge
summary: Holds a sworn bearing on the foe with the edge and ends the oath with a cut that seals the flow of its qi.

title: Treatise on the Plateau Gale Cut
summary: Teaches cuts made with the full force of a plateau gale and a crossing of open ground in a single breath.

title: Handbook of the Wind-Sworn Line
summary: Keeps a sworn line before the wind-sworn sabre that no foe's technique may cross without being cancelled.

title: Discourse on Bearing Taken at the Edge
summary: Takes a bearing at the very edge of a cliff and teaches cuts that fall with the drop and seal the foe's qi.

title: Canon of the Open Gale Sabre
summary: Teaches the sabre as an open steppe gale with dust and cross winds and a front that tears through a guard.

title: Treatise on the Oath Under Open Sky
summary: Keeps a vigil oath under open sky and gives back to a foe the force of the blow it aimed.

title: Book of the Plateau Reversal
summary: Turns every cut along the rim of the plateau into its reverse and closes the exchange with a flash of motion.

title: Study of the Sworn Bearing Held Alone
summary: A rare study for a Monarch who holds a sworn bearing alone and cancels every technique that crosses it.
